source: yueyue.wa (Ls12 archive hidden at file offset 0x500); character id c uses entries 2c (front view) and 2c+1 (back view), each 48x1280 = 20 frames of 48x64, index 0 transparent
layout: sheet 960x256: row = direction code d (0..3), column = frame 0..19

directions.evidence: loader 0x426c6a builds a 0x3c000 slot [2c+1 | mirror(2c) | 2c | mirror(2c+1)]; frame ptr 0x42b010 = slot + (dir*20 + frame)*0xC00 (dir = actor+0x2e, frame = actor+0x2a); walk steps set dir to the step code (0x42a4f5), whose deltas are dx@0x48b8c0 = (0,1,0,-1), dy@0x48b8b0 = (-1,0,1,0)

frames.3..19: action poses (common: 3 kneel, 4/5 raise arm, 6 hand to head/sweat, 8 bow, 12 lying/fallen; later frames are character specific)

anchor: actor screen point (sx, sy) is the bottom-left of the 48x64 frame: blit at (sx, sy-64) (0x42a2c4)

coordinates.actor fields: X = word +4, Y = word +6, Z = word +8 (0x42aa20/0x42add0/0x42adf0)
coordinates.W: word at Buha entry offset 8 (= 200 in every entry)
coordinates.screen: the 640x400 scene view is drawn at y = 40 (0x27b2b adds 0x28 to sy)
coordinates.units: isometric half-cells: +1 X -> (+8,+4) px, +1 Y -> (-8,+4) px, +1 Z -> -8 px

loader: actor create 0x426db2(person?, sprite_id) -> cache slot 0x426c6a(sprite_id, slot); sprite id comes straight from the S-script command
